schema: FMZ 2547 Pine v4 and verified printed 15m path

model.venue: Saved Binance USD-M BTCUSDT date window and 1h/15m periods, with a separate ETHUSDT replay. UTC date and venue session assumptions are explicit.
model.source: The archived dotted capital assignment fails to compile and its only literal is relocated to the declaration. Legacy v4 and weekday-preserving v5 controls match all chart-only numeric observations and broker output. The v5 replay also takes the archived 15m base feed.
model.signals: Three hl2 SMMAs (3/6/9), one close SMMA (50) and one close EMA (200) must be strictly stacked with price. The archived time condition permits entries at any hour. The close-all rule checks weekday 03:00–10:45 UTC membership at the 1h bar open. Separate dead date gates and size calculation remain in the program.
model.execution: One-unit next-open market entry, 300-tick bracket, archived 15m child OHLC endpoint order. The primary BTC ledger omits five official zero-print children from broker traversal only, preserving all 720 archived signal bars. The affected market entry uses the first positive-activity 15m open. Binance candles do not establish historical executable quotes, depth, or guaranteed fills.
model.costs: Two independent 50,000-USDT starting books. The native zero commission result defines gross P&L. The independent 0.075% per-side fee overlay leaves fills unchanged. Funding, spread and slippage are outside this accounting model. Drawdown uses time-aligned closed-trade equity.

coverage: Tested · Pine v4 SMMA/EMA and printed 15m execution
Saved BTC 1h/15m and cross-asset ETH, 268 independently verified closes. Five BTC zero-print base candles retained for signals but skipped for execution, with one disclosed lot difference.
